headline: President Clinton signed an order in 1994 updating the Manual for Courts-Martial, the rulebook for military trials.
what_it_does: This order changes the Manual for Courts-Martial, United States, 1984. That manual sets the rules for how military courts handle criminal cases against service members. The title alone does not say which specific rules were changed.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the US armed forces
who_it_affects.how: Service members charged with crimes under military law face trials run under the updated rules.

who_it_affects.group: Military judges, prosecutors, and defense lawyers
who_it_affects.how: They must follow the amended procedures when handling courts-martial.
